name: arsfuturo
description: ARS Futuro - backend Express + frontend Vite React

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C backend prisma:generate && pnpm -C frontend install
scripts.dev:all: pnpm -C backend dev && pnpm -C frontend dev
scripts.check: pnpm -C backend check && pnpm -C frontend check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
